caption:
Follow-up booked and not sure what happens next? Koko wondered too.

A review usually starts with a check-in on how things have been since your last visit and how the exercises went. Your practitioner then re-tests the movements from your first session to see what's changed.

From there, your plan gets adjusted. Exercises may progress or change, and hands-on treatment may be part of the session depending on what suits you. Bring notes on what's easier, what's still tricky and any goals coming up.

Our team at Hybrid Physio is always happy to explain the why behind your plan. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
